name: world-inheritance
description: World App mini app for WLD inheritance vaults (Foundry contracts + MiniKit frontend)

scripts.verify: npm run contracts:fmt:check && npm run contracts:test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.notify:d1:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply world-inheritance-notify --local --config backend/wrangler.toml
scripts.notify:d1:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply world-inheritance-notify --remote --config backend/wrangler.toml
